why: Definition item: only MPolyfold.IsScSmoothPartitionOfUnity and MPolyfold.AdmitsScPartitionsOfUnity are listed, so A = True and both implications are vacuous. The content is B itself, proved outright as B_holds: the project's notion (Mathlib PartitionOfUnity ι X, subordinate, every ρᵢ sc-smooth into realPolyfold) is the same as B's hand-written one (sc-smooth βₗ ≥ 0, locally finite closed supports, finsum = 1, tsupport βₗ ⊆ Uₗ). The only differences are packaging: Mathlib asks local finiteness of the supports {ρᵢ ≠ 0} (equivalent to that of their closures), continuity (part of IsScSmoothOn) and Σ ≤ 1 (from Σ = 1). In both, the index type is in the universe of X (Type at universe 0).
overlap: 0 shared project theorems (A_to_B via B_holds uses only Mathlib PartitionOfUnity API and the continuousOn field of IsScSmoothOn).
